_doc: IA priors for the DES/DECADE/BFD mocks. Rationale and evidence: Projects/des_decade_run/PRIORS.md. Adopted 2026-11-06. Amplitudes are in the package sign convention after the halo-IA sign fix: positive = physical (radial) alignment, same sign as NLA A > 0. Halo prior revised 2026-11-20 (NLA-spanning, low shot noise): see PRIORS.md.

a_c.doc: central GI amplitude a_c = f_c * A_c (sets the GI signal at fixed structure); A_c = a_c / f_c is derived. a_c ~ 0.33 A0_NLA (z0=0.3), so [-0.2, 0.5] ~ A0 in [-0.5, 1.5]

eta_c.doc: (1+z)/1.67 scaling of A_c; [-5,0] covers eta_NLA ~ [-1, 1+]; eta_NLA ~ -2 (needs -6..-10) deliberately excluded

A_s.doc: satellite alignment amplitude, independent of A_c (user decision 2026-11-20)

f_c.doc: self (shot-noise) term at fixed GI scales as 1/f_c; NLA coverage independent of f_c

noise_budget_rejection.rule: after building the halo-IA numerator, reject the (A_c, eta_c, A_s, eta_s) draw and redraw them on the same halo population if, in any tomographic bin, more than max_fraction of the footprint pixels have var_IA / var_noise > 1 (var_IA = 0.5 <numerator_sq> on NSIDE-64 superpixels, as in lensing.make_WL_sample)
noise_budget_rejection.status: disabled 2026-11-18 (max_fraction = 1): superseded by the local IA cap; set max_fraction back to 0.02 to restore the rejection. The capped-pixel fraction per bin is still stored in each mock (ia_noise_fraction).

ia_cap.rule: local IA cap (lensing.make_WL_sample / bfd_utils.make_BFD_sample ia_cap_alpha): in every pixel the halo-IA term is multiplied by s = min(1, sqrt(alpha var_noise / var_IA)) with var_IA the realised per-pixel self term; residual noise variance var_noise - s^2 var_IA
ia_cap.adopted: 2026-11-18; validation: Projects/ia_sc_validation/RESULTS.md (survey-target populations on the real DES Y6 / DECADE NGC / SGC catalogues: noise moments and couplings <= 0.4 sigma; the cap removes up to ~1.5 sigma of observed bin-1 signal only at eta ~ -2, |A_NLA| ~ 1, low f_c)

sharing: one IA draw per (simulation, baryon realisation, rotation), shared by all samples (DES Y6, BFD, DECADE NGC, SGC) -- current convention, to be confirmed
